'''Zygorf The Ultimate Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list Zygorf posted on DeckTech. The byline 'Darth "Zygorf" The Dark Jedi Master' is a prank name, so the player's real name is not known; he is listed by his DeckTech handle 'Zygorf' and no player page is made.<ref name="dt-21502">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21502 The Ultimate Deck], DeckTech (Darth "Zygorf" The Dark Jedi Master, 17 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21502/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21502/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015152840/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21502/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
